commits.summary: boot banners: header names the reader Draw_FlashMemUpdate_message_bitmap (22x28 B, MSB-left) and a line per banner with the routine that draws it, in v10/v9/v7

v10/v9 interrupt_vector_trampolines.s is not interrupt vectors. It is the tail of the 192-entry MIDI RX record-type handler table (reader MidiStream_DispatchLoop). Now typed as .long rows; the 4 false header lines are dropped. The deliberate one-byte perturbation made the gate fail here
scripts/lanes/sys/sys_lane_census.py: per-file census aggregator for the lane's own files
v7 banners: include v7's own .bin files again, because address_line_map's mirror cannot resolve ../../v10 paths; the reason is written in the header
new reframe_markers.py (unidasm framing, llvm-mc round trip), run to convergence on 6 v10 files; symboliser rewrote 516 operands and added 253 labels
same re-frame on v9: 15 passes, 516 operands, 253 labels
re-frame also covers .byte/.ascii misframes of 8 bytes or less; the trampoline header wording no longer reads as an admission

new convert_code_runs.py: code-suspect .byte runs become code, 83 per image. AudioMix_BytecodeData is really AudioMix_WriteAllGroupRegs/WriteGroupRegs8 (no caller). CDlikeSwTtl_DispatchData is 2 stubs plus CDlikeSwTtl_SendEvt4/SendStartEvtArg1 (the positional aliases now point to these)
new port_islands.py: v10 text ported onto v7 .byte islands and romslices by byte alignment, 16,528 B; v7 re-framed and symbolised

v7 drift zone: trampolines.s and screen_group_dispatch.s hold other code (v10 sndparam / dsp_config_sysex, +0x7D1); ported with --whole --delta, 17 unreferenced drifted labels dropped, the drifted SoundParam_NotifyChange label removed, headers explain
23 v7 notes '; v10 does not spell this byte either' shown false by byte alignment (check_stale_v10_notes.py), removed
v9 FlashWrite/ScreenData record area (0xF15907-0xF1627E) was data decoded as code; v10 text transplanted (same bytes). v7 head re-ported with v10 record structure. fast_build stale-ELF bug fixed
v7 InitializeCheap RegTitle block ported (macro prelude with tree symbols), 560 B; 86 v7 code-suspect runs converted

ScreenData continuation in flash_floppy_handlers.s (3,396 B x3), using the vendored seui model: one line per record, pointer fields as .long, tables typed, reader headers; 15 misnamed labels renamed SeScreenData_0xNNNN, 38 aliases retargeted, false .long pointers removed

new gui_tables.py: GUI_DisplayStructData/EmbeddedPtrTable/ToneGen_ParamTable cut into 92 labelled incbin slices at every lda-loaded or alias address; 73 RegisterObjectTable parameter blocks, 32 dispatch tables and 11 other reads get headers; 76 positional aliases are now real labels
HAMA factory test: tables registered by InitializeHama typed (FunctionProc/ApFunctionProc code+name pairs, parameter blocks); InitializeHama arguments made symbolic (v10/v9)
fd_test_data.s: 89 (v7 10) instruction lines that are strings/record fields turned back into .ascii/.byte; the '.long Naka_PresentationRootState' is really '.short 319, 239'
code that had been typed as .ascii (printable opcodes) turned back into code: MiddleFuncCall stubs, Demo*_DispatchTable stubs, TaskSched_TCBTemplate prologue, Voice_BankLookupCode
RegObjTable proc/data arguments made symbolic where an exact label exists: 112 of 210 in v10 and in v9
before/after census artefact with its commands (census_before_after_2026-09-25.txt); aggregator gains --rev

gate: make gate PASSES at head 42943c6c (9/9 KNOWN-5000 images IDENTICAL, all images assemble). It was run before every commit that touched sources. In commit 9c868b0b the gate was shown to fail on a deliberate one-byte perturbation (type-0x60 entry `- 22`: 'kn5000_v10_program 1 BYTES DIFFER'), and passed again after the byte was restored. The comment gate (assert_comments_preserved.py) passed on every commit, except for comments dropped on purpose because they were proven false; each such drop is named in its commit message (the trampoline and screen_group headers, and 23 stale '; v10 does not spell' notes). main's `lane_worklists.py --verify-branch sys main s2/sys`: PASS (71 paths changed).
not_done:
- The v7 numeric-branch count went 206 -> 226. Code ported from v10 brought branch sites that the symboliser refuses (R1/R3/mid-line-data), many of them into v7's 0x41A drift zone.
- About 16.5 KB is still KNOWN-B:
  - fd_test_data.s Naka widget records, about 2.1 KB per image. Record layouts need the Naka framework model.
  - HamaStr_* strings in test_data.s. In v7 all of test_data.s is untouched (1,866 B), because v7 test_init.s has no RegObjTable macro lines for hama_tables.py to parse.
  - Voice_FactoryPresetData, 480 B per image.
  - Boot FILETYPE_SIG strings and LED tables: no reader found beyond coincidental byte hits.
  - Small .byte instructions that llvm-mc cannot encode, e.g. the 7-byte `ld (XIX+WA),imm16` and `cp (XBC+IZ),0` forms in flash_floppy_handlers.s and fdemotext.
- GUI_DisplayStructData +0x0 (550 B) and +0x59C (436 B) per image have no reader: the lda/ld imm24/imm32 search and the LE24 search found nothing. The headers say so.
- The v10 names for v7 screen_group_dispatch.s / trampolines.s content (AudioVoice_Callback..UIStateEvt_*, SndParam_*) are not placed. v7 still defines those names, drifted, in audio/dsp_config_sysex.s and audio/sndparam_routines.s, which belong to other lanes.
- Retired romslice .bin files are not deleted; they are now referenced only by '(was .incbin ...)' notes. The orphaned slices other lanes listed are not deleted either: those lanes are unmerged.
- Remaining positional_labels cleanup (Str_*, TransposeNoteStr, etc.) not done.
- Data-shaped names on code not renamed: TaskSched_TCBTemplate, Demo{Style,Sound,Rhythm}_DispatchTable, MiddleFuncCall_DispatchData, Voice_BankLookupCode, AcApcToggleProc_Helper, DkMdlyPly_CheckState_Helper. The last two are used by 18 and 8 other lanes' files.
